commonLib.family: powerof3/CommonLibSSE (dev) + libxse/commonlib-shared, the lineage upstream builds with. NOT CommonLibSSE-NG 6.7.1: po3's code uses fork-specific APIs, and upstream's own August migration (BaseObjectSwapper/PapyrusExtender 2026-08-25) was a smaller, more faithful diff to follow than a port to NG.

toolchain.notes: Built at BelowNormal priority. Preset ninja-ae = base + ae (BUILD_SKYRIMAE=ON -> SKYRIM_AE, SKYRIM_SUPPORT_AE).

build.tests: none - upstream ships no test suite

package.layout: MO2 mod root = records/source-builds/ensrick-light-placer/ (SKSE/Plugins/po3_LightPlacer.dll + .pdb + po3_LightPlacer.ini, Scripts/LightPlacer.pex, Source/Scripts/LightPlacer.psc, LightPlacer-LICENSE.txt)
package.vendorParity: po3_LightPlacer.ini and Scripts/LightPlacer.pex are byte-identical to the parked vendor 4.2.1 install (pex sha256 ec08a9e4ce5eb8662f8b5eb97f8d372d5a6ff2730ae8750024be09f2b709b905); the vendor's AE FOMOD branch shipped exactly these plus the DLL/PDB

noPopups: REX::FAIL (commonlib-shared src/REX/LOG.cpp) is the only MessageBox path in the plug-in and its libraries; the overlay-port patch removes both MessageBoxA/W calls and keeps the critical log line + TerminateProcess. Address Library failures therefore land in po3_LightPlacer.log instead of a modal.
verified: Release build completes against powerof3/CommonLibSSE dev cbb5c29a1 + libxse/commonlib-shared b8f30fb8 with the upstream /W4 /WX flags, 0 warnings, 0 errors (build-lp.log 2026-09-01 23:38:40).
The DLL reports file version 4.2.1.1.0 and exports SKSEPlugin_Load and SKSEPlugin_Version (AE build: no SKSEPlugin_Query, same shape as the vendor 4.2.1.1 DLL).

commonlib-shared src/REL/IDDB.cpp at the pinned revision accepts Address Library format 5 (load_v5), which is the exact failure the vendor build logged.

No gameplay menu opened after AUTOLOAD_SETTLED (only Loading/Fader/HUD/LoadWaitSpinner/Cursor), so no human had the controls; launch_verify ended the run and no game process remained.
notVerified: In-game light rendering itself (a lit Lux CS interior with the ISL configs active) has not been eyeballed; the launch proves load, config parsing, hook installation, data-load processing (Models 267 / 295 lights) and a successful save load only.
The REX::FAIL log-only path has not been exercised on this DLL (it would need a deliberately missing Address Library).
